# Hunter — Beast Mastery

## Talent Prototype

This compact prototype uses two normal talent tiers plus one capstone. Talent identity and icon slugs are sourced from the Classic tree named **Beast Mastery**. There are no per-node prerequisite chains; unlocks are controlled only by the structured tier thresholds in this JSON.

identity.auto_attack: Beast Shot — ranged weapon damage; companion follows for 30% of shot damage

tier_1.name: Improved Aspect of the Hawk
tier_1.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

tier_2.name: Pathfinding
tier_2.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

capstones.name: Bestial Wrath
capstones.effect: Canonical Classic talent; prototype tuning is intentionally not substituted for the original talent text.

talent_model.tier_semantics: Talent tiers are prototype talent progression only and are unrelated to item/building T1–T5 progression.
